name: PT Soraya Berjaya Indonesia Tbk
summary: PT Soraya Berjaya Indonesia Tbk provides bedroom solutions in Indonesia. The company offers bed covers and sheets, bed lines, body pillows and bolsters, and household accessories under the Soraya Bed Sheet brand name. It also sells its products through stores, as well as online. PT Soraya Berjaya Indonesia Tbk was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Padang, Indonesia.
